criteria.criterion: Access Playwright GitHub Releases page (or reasonable official fallback) without signing in
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent accessed the correct GitHub Releases area for microsoft/playwright without signing in.
The newest non-preview release is correctly identified as v1.63.0 based on GitHub’s “Latest” marker and absence of pre-release labeling in the shown UI.

criteria.criterion: Record release metadata (tag and publication date) for the identified stable release
criteria.final_justification: Tag is supported by screenshots, but the agent’s specific calendar date (“2025-01-07”) is not supported by the visible evidence (only “4 days ago” is shown). Therefore only partial credit for providing tag but not a verifiable publication date.

criteria.criterion: Extract three distinct changes from the release notes of that stable release
criteria.final_justification: Only two distinct changes are visually confirmed as being in the GitHub release notes for v1.63.0. The third change claimed may be real, but it is not supported by the provided GitHub-release screenshots, so full credit for three extracted changes is not warranted.

criteria.criterion: Verify one of the listed changes using official Playwright documentation
criteria.final_justification: The agent verified one change (“Test locks”) using official Playwright documentation; screenshot 10 directly supports this verification with matching description and snippet. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Comply with constraints and stopping condition
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected (no sign-in; no creation actions). The provided predicted output also adheres to the stopping condition (it contains metadata, 3 changes, and one documentation verification, with no additional tasks performed).
